topic: Long-context prompts: documents first, question last, quote before answering (Anthropic docs)
text:
Pasting a 50-page document into a prompt and asking your question first? Anthropic's docs suggest flipping the order.

For inputs of 20k+ tokens, their guidance is:
• Put the long documents at the top
• Put your query and instructions after them
• Wrap each document in <document> tags with a <source>
• Ask the model to quote the relevant parts first, then answer

The docs say queries at the end can improve response quality by up to 30 percent in their tests, especially with complex, multi-document inputs.

My rule of thumb: for RAG or document Q&A, I'd build the prompt as documents, then quote-extraction step, then the question. It's a cheap change to test against your own eval set before trusting any benchmark.

Where do you put the question in your long prompts, and have you measured the difference?
